description: This Java class 'SystemResourceManager' manages Android system resources within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, providing methods to access resource directories, check resource visibility, and retrieve attribute definitions.

classes.name: SystemResourceManager
classes.description: A class that manages Android system resources, providing access to resource directories, resource visibility checks, and attribute definitions.

methods.name: isResourcePublic
methods.description: Checks if a resource of a given type and name is public, considering the 'myPublicOnly' flag.

methods.name: getAllResourceDirs
methods.description: Returns all resource directories as VirtualFile array.

methods.name: getResourceDir
methods.description: Private helper method to retrieve the main resource directory as a VirtualFile.

methods.name: isResourceDir
methods.description: Checks if a given VirtualFile is the resource directory managed by this class.

methods.name: getResourceDirs
methods.description: Returns a list containing the resource directory VirtualFile.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to obtain the SystemResourceManager instance from a ConvertContext.

methods.name: getAttributeDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves attribute definitions associated with the current Android platform.
